title: IncrementSkill - Game
content:
Member of: Game Script Advances the provided Skill by the one point (for the player only). Syntax: Function IncrementSkill(ActorValue akActorValue, int aiCount = 1) native global Parameters: - akActorValue: The Skill to teach to the player. - aiCount: The number of points to advance the skill. Default: 1 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Advance the given skill on the player by the one point Game.IncrementSkill(MarksmanSkillAV)
; Advance the given skill on the player by 10 points Game.IncrementSkill(SmallGunSkillAV, 10) See Also: - Game Script
